entries.trigger: Elisha got a double portion of the anointing.
entries.answer: That's inheritance language. He asked to be the heir, not to be twice as strong.

entries.trigger: The disciples already had the Holy Spirit.
entries.answer: Yahushua said the Spirit was with them and would be in them. Two different things.
Yahushua said it hadn't been given yet. He said that after John was dead.

entries.trigger: Joel said in the last days Yahuah would pour out His Spirit.
entries.answer: Joel described a condition, not an event. A new temple, not a revival.

entries.trigger: Peter calls believers a royal priesthood. That's a New Testament thing.
entries.answer: It's a quote from Sinai. He offered it to every household before He narrowed it to one.

entries.trigger: Our job is to change the culture.
entries.answer: Salt slows corruption. It does not reverse it. You were given a mark to carry, not a world to fix.

entries.trigger: He's preparing a mansion for me.
entries.answer: He said dwelling, not mansion. And He said He would make it with you, here.

entries.trigger: Satan fell from heaven with a third of the angels.
entries.answer: The apostles reported the fruit; Yahushua told them what it meant in the unseen world.

entries.trigger: The oil in the ten virgins is the Holy Spirit.
entries.answer: The ten virgins is not a story about being late, and it is not a story about how much of the Spirit anyone had.

entries.trigger: The law is written on my heart now. I do not need the written commandments.
entries.answer: Your body is the temple, and what was kept in its innermost room was the law. The deepest place in a man holds a standard, not a feeling.

entries.trigger: Satan is the god of this world. This world is his.
entries.answer: Two princes are named in the Book, and neither one holds a deed. Allegiance shows up in the statutes a man keeps.

entries.trigger: Isaiah was all fulfilled at the first coming.
entries.answer: Isaiah runs in four blocks, in order, each covering its own stretch of time. Not one verse in the last block has ever been quoted as already fulfilled.

entries.trigger: The blood is what saves me. The rest is legalism.
entries.answer: The cup is entry — the blood, the door, the way in. The bread is the walk that follows, and a man who takes the cup and never touches the bread has sat down in the entryway.
When they replaced Judas they did not vote on character. They named one requirement: the man had to have walked with Yahushua from the immersion of John and seen Him risen. Nobody alive can meet it.

entries.trigger: The law was nailed to the cross.
entries.answer: A monument of the ten commandments goes up outside a courthouse and the crowd cheers. That same week the sermon says the law was nailed to the cross. One of those two is wrong, and it is not the stone.

entries.trigger: Yahuah replaced Israel with the church.
entries.answer: Ask what the owner came to collect. Not grapes, not attendance, not a building — righteousness in his people. The renters were removed. The vineyard stayed exactly where it was.
